# Product, Performance Marketing

## Location

Remote; United States

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Hybrid

## Department

Agency

## About Valid

Founded in July 2023, Valid is a seed-stage company operating at Series A scale, headquartered in San Francisco.

In under two years, we’ve grown from 5 people to 40+, deployed over $1B in ad spend, and built a full-stack, tech-enabled advertising company serving enterprise consumer customers.

We’re well-capitalized and backed by top Silicon Valley investors including Canaan, Neo, and others.

## This Role is for you if you are:

- A tech and startup obsessed marketing operator

- First in line to try the newest AI marketing tool

- Passionate about ad networks and performance marketing

- Obsessed with discovering and tracking social media trends


_We believe that the best form of marketing is AI-assisted, data-driven and human in-the-loop. This role is for a performance marketing expert who is excited about being the glue between these layers, straddling marketing and product development._

## **The Role**

**Performance Marketing (85% of your time)**

- Interface directly with clients

- Define what the ideal campaign structure is for Valid clients

- Manage and hire a team of marketers to use tooling you help design to deliver a best-in-class ads experience


**Product (15% of your time)**

- Interface directly with engineering translating marketing processes into real products


## About you

- 7+ years of performance marketing experience within an agency or head of growth role

- Manage +$500,000/month of ad spend across the following platforms:

- Meta

- TikTok

- Google

- Other advertising channels

- Comfortable analyzing data and deploying statistical methods to “read the tea leaves” of an ad account.

- Served in client facing roles as senior POC


**Nice to Have**

- Managed and hired a team of marketers

- Advertising for mobile apps, mobile app attribution (SKAN), and Apple ads


**You’re Probably a Good Fit If:**

- Applying the latest tech in novel ways to delight customers excites you

- Your goal is to maximize ownership

- You want to join something early stage

- The idea of organized chaos is what you want

- Organized: Build with purpose, work efficiently, communicate clearly, especially in writing.

- Chaos: We think the best place to learn is in market and will do what it takes to ship as quickly as possible.


**This Role Might Not Be a Fit If:**

- You don’t enjoy wearing multiple hats

- Don’t enjoy mentoring others

- Dislike navigating ambiguity


## Compensation Range

- Competitive Salary

- Equity

- Benefits: 401k, healthcare, FSA, lunch (for in-person days)

- Location: Remote friendly with a preference for in-person out of our office in San Francisco.


[Apply for this Job](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Valid/165d053b-a047-4bc5-9dca-7f189c8c5bca/application)
